name: Kenco / The Shippers Group - Hutchins TX (HQ campus)

fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced/secured yard (corroborated by The Shippers Group's own facility page describing a 'secured yard'). 2026-02 Street View shows a chain-link perimeter all the way around the dock/yard area with a sliding gate across the SE truck entrance driveway.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clear dedicated 1-3-car guard booth. There IS a long metal building beside the entrance, but it reads as an office/annex/maintenance building rather than a gatehouse. With a controlled gate but no obvious booth, classified remoteGs (kiosk / app / call-box check-in likely).
fieldNotes.remoteGs: True because there is a truck gate but no identifiable guard shack.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: The Shippers Group facility page states 89 dock doors plus 5 rail doors; Street View / satellite confirm a long dock bank on the east face with trailers backed in. Band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Drop / trailer parking along the east and NE yard holds 25-50 unhitched trailers within the secured yard.
fieldNotes.railServed: TRUE - facility page states served by Union Pacific Railroad with 5 rail doors; a rail line runs along the NW edge of the property with a spur into the site.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Counted the main 560k SF warehouse plus the adjacent long metal annex/office building as 2 buildings, but this is a single facility/parcel, not a multi-cluster campus - multipleFacilities false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Hutchins is an edge-of-metro DFW industrial-park setting south of Dallas off I-45, surrounded by farmland and scattered warehouses; classified Rural per the small-town-industrial tie-breaker.
fieldNotes.facts: 1015 W Wintergreen Rd / WG-2: 560,000 SF, built 2018, 109,000 SF cooler, multi-client food-grade BRC-certified. Former TSG corporate HQ; The Shippers Group acquired by Kenco Jan 2024.
